_meta.cleanReviewFirst: #3537 (version 2): /work reviews a never-reviewed or stale-reviewed issue itself before its first AC instead of warning or offering, because only /review-issue Step 2a-ii writes the Files to modify declaration scope drift, always-protected licensing and --concurrent planning depend on. warn-proceed was removed; a declined stop no longer proceeds unless the waiver flag is passed.

actionMeanings.review: Review the issue before its first AC through one idpf-issue-reviewer agent (node .claude/scripts/shared/lib/issue-reviewer-brief.js --issue N, --stale for stale-reviewed; always --step-wise), with no status move. Its verdict decides: reviewed proceeds; pending is handled as findings-pending for the same shape; a failed review (labelAssigned null, or the reviewer failed) stops — never treated as clean.
actionMeanings.stop: STOP and offer the named command via AskUserQuestion; accepting hands off to it and STOPs with the issue's status unchanged; declining also STOPs unless the waiver flag (--unreviewed) was passed.
actionMeanings.halt: Halt the --nonstop run on the same terms as any test/AC/QA/gh pmu failure.
